{{Top}}
[[File:SonicBlaster-NEGWT.png|250px|thumb|A Geonosian sonic blaster]]
A '''sonic blaster''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapon incorporating sonic wave technology to fire an extremely concentrated mass of sound instead of plasma bolts.

Enhanced sonic blasters were mounted on [[Waveskimmer/Legends|waveskimmers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Models of sonic blaster included:
*[[Geonosian sonic blaster/Legends|Geonosian sonic blaster]], produced on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] by [[Gordarl Weaponsmiths/Legends|Gordarl Weaponsmiths]]
*[[LR1K sonic cannon/Legends|LR1K sonic cannon]], a larger, turret-mounted version of the Geonosian blaster
*[[Imperial sonic blaster]], used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officers during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]
*[[Kob sonic blaster]], used by the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] during the [[Nagai–Tof War]]
*[[Shadowman sonic blaster]], used by the [[Shadowman|Shadowmen]] of [[Nivek]]
